about.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
about.head: f2d5711

body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️ Please note: It usually takes 48–72 hours for a landed PR to be released (except P0+ fixes). We have many more exciting PRs and features coming in later versions! ## The short version **Add project is back where you can find it.** The sidebar used to hide *New workspace* and *Add project* behind different affordances depending on how wide your window was. Now there is one **Create** button and both live inside it — same labels, same place, every window size. **Structured chat grew up.** Turn on *Structured Chat* in Experimental settings and agent output reads like a conversation: tool calls grouped into batches, execution details you can open, Codex subagent activity instead of raw opcodes, `/clear` and `/compact`, renameable tabs, hover timestamps, and resume straight from Agent Session History. Native Windows gets structured Codex chat too. **Remote work holds on better.** Relay region selection, rehoming, and reconnects are steadier on desktop and cloud. Terminals keep their input, output, and identity through recovery, restart, and scrollback replay. **It's quicker.** A large pass removed redundant re-renders, rescans, and allocations across the renderer, sidebar, terminals, Git parsing, and catalog indexing. **Two things were pulled.** The mobile relay connect-speed work and background mobile push were reverted for a further pass — they are not in this release. --- ## Product experience ### Workspaces & projects *Making a new thing from the sidebar is now one **Create** button, and the sidebar stops losing your filters, hosts, and project list.* **One Create button** * Unify sidebar create actions into single dropdown menu by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19375 **Sidebar keeps its place** * fix(sidebar): reveal collapsed workspaces without clearing filters by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19398 * fix(ui): ignore the persistent workspace list when detecting overlays by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18881 * Persist agents sidebar search visibility as pairing-local preference by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19313 * fix(sidebar): label pinned rows with their host on a multi-host sidebar by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19351 * fix(ui): keep source control headers readable in narrow sidebars by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19146 **Projects & worktrees** * fix(runtime): stop a first status publication retiring in-flight worktree scans by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19357 * fix: avoid duplicate repository groups during catalog refresh by @kiendle in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19170 ### Editor, browser & UI *⌘J finds what you actually meant, the browser and address bar behave, and the activity list sorts by what needs you.* **Command palette (⌘J)** * Seed Cmd-J filter from sidebar scope by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19036 * Improve cmd j ranking by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19005 * fix(cmd-j): pass browser tab ownership into palette search by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18925 * fix(cmd-j): remove duplicate browser ownership inputs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19172 **Browser** * fix(browser): select full URL on initial address bar click by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19118 * fix: avoid starting browser helpers just to reset absent sessions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18952 * fix: fence browser recovery to attach inventory placements by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18910 * fix: preserve renderer browser publication during client-hosted page updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18961 * Defer inactive browser pages across worktree switches by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19326 **Editor & diffs** * fix(editor): support Shift+wheel scrolling in combined diffs by @brohoya in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/11756 * fix: open editor rename after context menu releases focus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18934 * Recover branch compare on visibility change by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19021 **Activity view** * Rank activity status groups by attention level by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19329 * fix(activity): show working agents under "unread only" by giving working turns a read receipt by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19535 * Organize activity menu into filter and view sections by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19547 **Ports, logs & diagnostics** * fix(ports): coalesce advertised URL refresh bursts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19150 * fix(gh): log when gh/glab is killed at its deadline by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18555 * Log error details on session kill failure by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19381 ### Settings & localization *More of the interface speaks your language.* * Add localization for activity view and sidebar by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18589 * fix(i18n): drop orphan TerminalPane.minimumContrast entries that broke main static analysis by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19566 ## Agents & workflow ### Agents & native chat *Structured chat (Settings → Experimental → **Structured Chat**) reads like a conversation instead of a protocol dump.* **Reading the conversation** * feat(native-chat): read a tool batch as a group by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19372 * feat(native-chat): add execution details and tool row identity by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19226 * feat(native-chat): show Codex subagent activity instead of opcode rows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18773 * fix(native-chat): render compaction notices, plan documents, and images by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19228 * Show native chat message timestamps on hover by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19218 * Show provider activity in chat turn tails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19055 * Add persistent turn-scoped chat activity indicator by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19044 * Stabilize scrollbar gutter to prevent message list layout shift by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19332 * feat(native-chat): offer the link-action popover for chat links by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19130 * fix(native-chat): suppress provider user echoes in Claude and Codex by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19136 **Steering the session** * feat(chat): support structured /clear and /compact commands by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19164 * feat(native-chat): resume an Agent Session History row into a new structured chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19176 * fix(native-chat): make structured chat tabs renameable by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19153 * fix(native-chat): remember structured chat model and effort picks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19147 * fix(native-chat): list the slash commands and skills a structured Claude session actually loaded by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19127 * fix(native-chat): auto-rename the workspace on a structured chat's first turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19138 * Fix native chat completion sorting and restored activity timestamps by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19144 * feat(chat): add structured session rewind backend by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19235 **Turns that used to get stuck** * fix(native-chat): settle a structured send the provider proves it received after the ack window by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19140 * fix(native-chat): settle structured chat turns stranded by a restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19122 * fix(native-chat): stop seeding a stray terminal beside a chat create by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19123 * fix(native-chat): stop an unanswered host from reading as one that refuses structured chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19321 * fix(native-chat): scope composer file drops to the pane that received them by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19328 * fix(runtime): apply the structured-chat setting to every RPC caller by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18700 * fix(codex): keep large app-server replies alive by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18590 * fix(chat): stop terminal focus recovery from stealing Cmd+C in the Chat UI by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18751 * fix: restore the full sidebar agent row for structured native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19137 * fix(agent-status): stop a stale self-authored agent title from faking a pending question by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19237 * fix(pi): show input modals as waiting instead of working by @mmarabel in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18836 * fix(pi): finish the dialog-wait signal on every surface by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19533 **Providers & accounts** * Fix MiniMax China usage routing and credential handling by @weekbin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/14929 * Fix MiniMax credential-expiry reporting, region sync, and refresh by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19250 * fix(codex): distinguish personal and enterprise accounts sharing an email by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19279 * fix(rate-limits): stop reporting Grok usage as 0% when the API omits the percent by @TimothyVang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/17936 * fix: recognize the kimi-code process as the kimi agent by @Aladex in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18634 ### Automations *Multi-agent runs survive an app restart, keep their worker lineage, and refuse the moves that used to strand a task.* **Durability & lineage** * feat(orchestration): make multi-agent workflows durable by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16904 * fix(orchestration): keep worker lineage across app restart (STA-6366) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19121 * Remove settled-worker automatic resume and hibernation fences by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19544 **Dispatch, mail & tasks** * fix(orchestration): file federated worker mail under the coordinator Run by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19542 * fix(orchestration): refuse Task re-open under a live worker; allow stop re-issue on a stranded row by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19551 * feat(orchestration): orchestrate native-born structured chat sessions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18827 **Status & titles** * fix(orchestration): recover Codex idle after completion title race by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19243 * fix(orchestration): avoid full message scans on working terminal titles by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19390 ### Terminal & CLI *Fewer ways for a pane to lose your input, your output, or itself.* **Your input and output survive** * fix: preserve user input during terminal scrollback replay by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19075 * fix: repaint hidden output overflow after answered restore deadline by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18904 * fix: eliminate quadratic whitespace trimming during fullscreen scrolling by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19214 * fix: preserve terminal command probes across control frames by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19006 * fix(terminal): preserve ordinary foreground command names by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18882 **Panes recovering & retiring** * fix: prefer retained provider snapshots during hidden terminal recovery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18972 * fix(terminal): remount a pane left unbound by a spawn that returned no PTY id by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19223 * fix: preserve terminal retirement proof across renderer publications by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19002 * Fix native PTY I/O failures disabling session termination by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19523 * fix: keep macOS shell ownership proof within recovery budget by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18932 * fix: preserve overlay focus during terminal mounting and layout by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18982 **Rendering & readability** * feat(terminal): make the contrast floor user-configurable (#10754) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18126 * fix(xterm): remove scrollback decorations by identity by @bbingz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/13178 * fix: release floating terminal WebGL contexts while closed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19000 * fix(terminal): fold-safe CAN/SUB and double-ESC handling in partial-escape tail by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19521 ## Remote & platform ### SSH, relay & remote *Phones and remote hosts pick a sane relay region, get rehomed correctly, and keep their panes through reconnects.* **Region selection & rehoming** * fix(relay): stop rejecting the near region on a cold first probe by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19233 * fix(relay): never cache a region hint from a one-region catalog by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19349 * fix(relay): rehome hosts to their preferred region in either direction by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19241 * fix(relay-ops): let the rehome trust probe approve the asia-east2 cells by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19275 * relay: give the asia-east2 cells the regional rehome identity by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19239 * feat(relay): alert on far-cell placement and skewed region hints by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19253 **Connections & control channel** * fix(relay): attach a phone whose accept straddles a control rebind (desktop side) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19238 * fix(relay): emit pending-conn details to hosts that advertise the capability (cell side) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19266 * fix(relay): bound control RTT samples per ping and per flush window by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19268 * feat(relay): time successful client accepts and control round trips by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19232 * fix(ssh-relay): daemon owns the endpoint credential; a losing start never rotates it by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19052 * feat(relay): log the region probe and name the assigned cell by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19307 * perf(mobile): cut the relay reconnect critical path and admit dead sockets faster by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19236 * revert(mobile): hold the relay reconnect path and cache-first reconnect for a separate mobile pass by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19265 **Remote panes & tabs** * fix: honor remote terminal insertion in the calling client by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18995 * fix: keep paired tab updates live after runtime terminal fallback by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19022 * fix(remote): keep terminal tabs syncing after orphan recovery by @shaharmor in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19065 * fix(terminal): remove host-retired ghost panes in paired remote splits (#17770) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19365 * fix: preserve paired host sessions during startup residue cleanup by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18922 * fix: avoid credit deadlock during large SSH PTY recovery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19026 * fix(clipboard): route runtime-owned SSH image paste through the runtime by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19352 ### Windows & WSL *Structured Codex chat runs on native Windows; WSL1 and MSYS shells are recognized properly.* **Structured chat on native Windows** * feat(windows): enable structured Codex chat on native Windows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18519 * fix(windows): unblock structured native chat by exposing process creation time by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18986 **Processes & shells** * fix(windows): reject stale parent PID links in shutdown snapshots by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19149 * fix: retain MSYS shell descendants in their terminal job by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19068 * fix: recognize working WSL1 without a WSL2 kernel by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19061 * fix(agent-hooks): guard every Windows missing-target fallback before it reads stdin by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19415 ### Mobile *Structured native Claude chat lands. Two larger efforts were pulled for another pass.* **Shipped** * feat(mobile): structured native Claude chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18741 * fix(mobile): stop double-scaling commit timestamps in history rows by @blade035 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/17731 **Landed, then pulled for a further pass — not in this build** * feat: real background push notifications for the mobile app (#8129) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18554 * revert: hold mobile push feature for user testing by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19203 * feat(mobile): draw the last known tab strip while a session reconnects by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19258 * feat(mobile): draw the last known tab strip while a session reconnects (mobile pass) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19281 * feat(mobile): time relay dial stages so diagnostics say where a slow connect went by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19245 * revert(mobile): pull the relay connect-speed mobile pass pending a smaller, verified re-land by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19348 ## Quality & delivery *Nothing here changes what you see — it changes how fast it gets there and how confidently it ships. Expanded below if you want the detail.*
Performance: interface & workspace — 10 PRs * perf(store): keep the repo list's identity through workspace hydration by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19057 * perf(tabs): keep tab-model identity when reconciliation changed something else by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19063 * perf(mobile): skip the agent-status projection join when nothing changed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19115 * perf(worktrees): stop worktree removal from replacing maps it never touched by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19058 * perf(selectors): stop two always-mounted selectors allocating per store write by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19113 * perf(store): detect Zustand rerender churn the current audit cannot see by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19059 * perf(agent-status): stop no-op retirements rebuilding the retired-pane-key map by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19142 * perf(worktrees): stop worktree teardown replacing arrays and maps it never touched by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19145 * perf(renderer): avoid per-second spinner animation events by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19407 * perf: memoize ancestry when selecting foreground agents by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19502
